knobs.note: Read by bin/fly-idle-check.sh as ${FLY_IDLE_HOURS:-2}: a started machine with no pool build, dispatcher job or queue claim is idle once it has been up MORE than this many hours. 0 or non-numeric falls back to 2 and the fallback is logged.

Read by bin/fly-idle-check.sh as ${FLY_IDLE_IGNORE_APPS:-}: a comma list of Fly app names (exact match) whose machines are never read or flagged — an always-on service that is meant to run idle. Counted as ignored= in the lane log.

Read by bin/fly-idle-check.sh as ${FLY_IDLE_MAX_APPS:-60}: the most apps whose machines one run reads, in API order. Apps past it are named in the alert as `partial: K apps not checked`, never dropped silently.
Read by bin/fly-idle-check.sh as ${FLY_IDLE_HTTP_TIMEOUT:-25}: curl -m for each GET against the Fly Machines API.

no static default — the script computes it ($H/catalog/fly-prices.json). Read by bin/fly-idle-check.sh as ${FLY_PRICES:-$H/catalog/fly-prices.json}, the table fly_price_per_s prices each idle machine's hourly burn from. NOT settable from the control plane — it is a command, a host, a path, an identity or a test seam a root lane uses, so only env/global.env on the box moves it; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.

no static default — the script computes it ($(date -u +%s)). Read by bin/fly-idle-check.sh as ${FLY_IDLE_NOW:-$(date -u +%s)}: the clock the lane measures uptime and the UTC day marker from. NOT settable from the control plane — it is a command, a host, a path, an identity or a test seam a root lane uses, so only env/global.env on the box moves it; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.

no static default — bin/lib/endpoints.sh supplies it on the box. Read by bin/fly-idle-check.sh as ${JOBS_URL:-}: the jobs worker the lane asks for live queue claims before calling a machine idle; unset leaves the queue column unread(not configured). NOT settable from the control plane — it is a command, a host, a path, an identity or a test seam a root lane uses, so only env/global.env on the box moves it; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.
